message.content: Based on the conversations in the provided data, Thrall has mentioned supporting local businesses as a key component of their garden project. In one of the discussions, Thrall suggests creating a combined effort between the garden and local vendors to ensure that the project not only enhances the community but also strengthens local economic ties. Specifically, Thrall notes, "Looks like we're all on the same page about this project! Keep sharing your thoughts, everyone! Can't wait to see the combined efforts of our garden and local businesses shine! 🌼🌍". This indicates that Thrall believes in fostering a partnership between the garden renovation and local business owners to promote local commerce.
